There is no package.json to add zod to. The repository at this worktree, context-report, contains no package.json, pnpm lockfile, or pnpm workspace file anywhere, whether tracked, untracked, or gitignored. Its git history has never had one either.

What I checked:

- **git HEAD** has no package.json, and no tracked file matches any lockfile name.
- **Untracked and ignored files** contain no manifest or lockfile.
- **pnpm and node** are installed on this machine, so the tooling is not the blocker.

The request text matches the prompt in evals/n8n-pnpm-add-dep, which targets the n8n monorepo, not this repo. I did not create a package.json here, since that would invent a manifest the request says already exists and would land a Node project inside a paper measurements folder.

To do this in the intended repo, run the following from the package directory there, then commit both package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml:

```
pnpm add zod
```

If you do want a new Node package created in this repo, say where it should live and I will set it up with pnpm and add zod. Note that the repo's verify-dependency-exists gate will also require zod to be listed in .chock/dependency-allowlist.txt before the commit passes.
